experiments.study_type: Cuboid microdissection and 3D imaging of mouse liver
experiments.procedure_text: Mouse liver cut into cuboids with tissue chopper, fixed, optically cleared, imaged by open-top light-sheet microscopy to characterize microenvironment.
experiments.procedure_text_evidence: we performed open-top light-sheet (OTLS) microscopy of fixed and optically-cleared liver cuboids
experiments.test_system_evidence: we performed open-top light-sheet (OTLS) microscopy of fixed and optically-cleared liver cuboids

endpoints.label: Tissue viability (dead/dying cell layers)
endpoints.evidence: outer edges of the cuboid had ~1-3 layers of dead or dying cells

endpoints.label: 3D microenvironment characterization (vasculature, nuclei)
endpoints.evidence: we identified the cuboid surface, vascular spaces, and cell nuclei

substances.name: TO-PRO 3 nuclear dye
substances.evidence: Staining with far-red fluorescent TO-PRO 3 nuclear dye

experiments.notes: Livers from male nude mice without tumors used for intact cuboid imaging; chopping quantitation used C57BL6-derived mouse livers. First liver cut used vibratome.

experiments.study_type: Cuboid size distribution and sample yield analysis (mouse liver)
experiments.procedure_text: Freshly microdissected mouse liver cuboids analyzed before and after filtering to evaluate size distribution and tissue sample loss.
experiments.procedure_text_evidence: We analyzed freshly microdissected cuboids before and after filtering both from mouse liver
experiments.species_evidence: livers from adult (3 months old) C57BL6-derived mice
experiments.test_system_evidence: freshly microdissected cuboids before and after filtering both from mouse liver

endpoints.label: Cuboid size distribution
endpoints.evidence: We evaluated the size distribution and sample loss

endpoints.label: Tissue sample loss/yield
endpoints.evidence: how much of the initial liver and glioma tissue sample loss occurs

experiments.notes: n=6 data sets analyzed for mouse liver.

experiments.study_type: U87 glioma xenograft cuboid culture and microenvironment characterization
experiments.procedure_text: U87 glioma flank xenograft tumors microdissected into cuboids, cultured, and characterized for viability, proliferation, apoptosis and microenvironment markers.
experiments.procedure_text_evidence: U-87MG (U87) glioma cell-derived xenograft flank tumors
experiments.species_evidence: male athymic nude mice (Taconic, Foxn1 nu )
experiments.test_system_evidence: evaluated the viability and microenvironment of U87 glioma cuboids after two days in culture

endpoints.label: Cuboid viability (SYTOX green/Hoechst)
endpoints.evidence: we performed live viability staining of the cuboids

endpoints.label: Microenvironment cell markers (CD31, CD45)
endpoints.evidence: continued presence of endothelial cells (CD31) and immune cells (CD45)

substances.name: SYTOX green (SG)
substances.evidence: the green fluorescent dead nuclear stain, SYTOX green (SG)

substances.name: Hoechst (H)
substances.evidence: the blue fluorescent pan-nuclear stain, Hoechst (H)

substances.name: Cisplatin
substances.evidence: a 2-day maximal drug treatment (100 μM Cisplatin)

exposure.conditions: cultured within a collagen hydrogel layer on top of a Transwell insert

experiments.exposure_evidence: the mean increase (1.4) seen after a 2-day maximal drug treatment (100 μM Cisplatin)
experiments.notes: U87 cells injected subcutaneously into nude mouse flank to generate xenograft tumors. Cisplatin here used as threshold reference for viability staining.

experiments.study_type: Cisplatin drug treatment of U87 cuboids on microfluidic device
experiments.procedure_text: U87 glioma cuboids loaded in microfluidic device treated with varying cisplatin concentrations for two days; cell viability measured via SYTOX green/Hoechst fluorescence ratio.
experiments.procedure_text_evidence: we exposed U87 cuboids in the device with different concentrations of a cytotoxic chemotherapy drug, cisplatin
experiments.species_evidence: male athymic nude mice (Taconic, Foxn1 nu )
experiments.test_system_evidence: we exposed U87 cuboids in the device with different concentrations

endpoints.label: Cuboid cell death/viability response to cisplatin
endpoints.evidence: we measured the mean fluorescence ratio ... SG dead nuclear fluorescence to Hoechst

exposure.conditions: two wells with each concentration in each of two devices

experiments.exposure_evidence: we treated two wells with each concentration of cisplatin (0, 10, 30, 100 μM) for 2 days
experiments.notes: Cuboids derived from U87 glioma xenografts in nude mice. Off-device parallel experiments used 100 μM cisplatin.
